import asyncio
from openai import AsyncOpenAI
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import numpy as np

emb = SentenceTransformer("{{embed_model}}")
llm = AsyncOpenAI()
DOCS, VECS = [], None

def ingest(docs):
    global DOCS, VECS
    DOCS = docs
    VECS = emb.encode(docs, normalize_embeddings=True)

async def answer(q: str) -> str:
    qv = emb.encode([q], normalize_embeddings=True)
    idx = np.argsort(-(VECS @ qv.T).flatten())[:4]
    ctx = "\n".join(DOCS[i] for i in idx)
    r = await llm.chat.completions.create(model="{{model_name}}",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"{ctx}\nQ: {q}"}])
    return r.choices[0].message.content

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ingest(["cats meow", "dogs bark"])
    print(asyncio.run(answer("what do cats say?")))
